summary: Official Odisha Bhulekh/BhuNaksha services and the Puri district land-record custodian were verified. Current BhuNaksha JavaScript and bounded anonymous administrative REST requests were inspected, but no safe parcel ID plus full polygon geometry response or CRS was obtained; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Odia discovery queries, exact text and actual result URLs are recorded in city-11599-puri.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GETs retrieved the current BhuNaksha page, config, JavaScript, Bhulekh map form and official Puri district procedure page. Anonymous POSTs returned five BhuNaksha levels and Puri district/tehsil/RI administrative values. No parcel geometry response was obtained.
